objects.description: A class that incrementally estimates the mean of a data stream using Welford's algorithm and exposes statistical properties. It supports resetting, processing new samples, retrieving the count and mean, and computing variance and relative squared error. Implementation details (e.g., initialization values, exact formulas) are not present in this header.

functions.name: StatisticsEstimator::StatisticsEstimator
functions.description: Default constructor for StatisticsEstimator. Initializes the estimator to an empty state, ready to accept samples and compute streaming statistics (mean and related properties) using Welford's algorithm. Usage: construct an instance, then call process(...) repeatedly, and query results via getters or calculation methods.

functions.name: StatisticsEstimator::reset
functions.description: Resets the estimator to its initial empty state. Clears accumulated statistics so a new stream can be processed from scratch. Usage: call at any time to discard prior samples before processing new data with process(...).

functions.name: StatisticsEstimator::process
functions.description: Processes a single sample value x into the running statistics using Welford's online update. Use this to feed the data stream sequentially before querying mean or derived statistics.
requirements: x is a double value; no further constraints are documented.
The estimator instance must be constructed (and optionally reset) before calling.

functions.name: StatisticsEstimator::getCount
functions.description: Returns the number of samples that have been processed so far.

functions.name: StatisticsEstimator::getMean
functions.description: Returns the current mean of the processed samples. If no samples were processed, the returned value is implementation-defined/unknown based on this header alone.
requirements: If zero samples have been processed, the meaning of the returned value is unspecified in this header.

functions.name: StatisticsEstimator::calculateVariance
functions.description: Computes the variance of the processed samples based on the accumulated state (consistent with Welford’s algorithm). Intended to be called after feeding samples via process(...).
requirements: Behavior/return value when fewer than 2 samples have been processed is not specified in this header; callers should ensure at least 2 samples before calling to avoid undefined/degenerate results. (Inferred from common variance definition.)

functions.name: StatisticsEstimator::calculateRelativeErrorSq
functions.description: Calculates the squared relative error of the mean estimate from the processed samples. Exact definition/formula is not documented here; it is likely derived from variance and mean (e.g., variance/count divided by mean^2).
requirements: Exact semantics are not specified in this header; callers should expect undefined/degenerate results if zero samples have been processed.
If the mean is zero or near zero, the result may be undefined, infinite, or NaN depending on implementation. (Inferred from the name and typical formula.)
